title: Modern Media, Optical Communications
lineage: Contemporary outside trade publication, accessed as a World Radio History facsimile. The item’s reporting origins and access to circuit logs are unspecified. The local reading notes identify the inspected scan by SHA-256.

passages.locator: Printed p. 107 / PDF p. 121, Optical Communications subsection
passages.note: The article dates the Illinois Bell downtown service evaluation to 11 May 1977 and describes voice, data and video through 24 fibers linking two switching offices and the Brunswick Building. It describes the separate GTE link between Long Beach and Artesia earlier in the same subsection.
